about: Free-form held-out set B (written 2026-10-29, blind: the author did not read Cierra's prompt, its few-shot examples or the tuner before writing). 40 notes written the way a director or colourist talks, outside the note-check vocabulary (no probe pattern matches any note: checked with cierra.notes.probes_for), each with hidden checks in the checks' own phrases, written before any model run and never to be shown to a model. 24 cases carry a colour-axis check (glow, faded, washed out, drained, saturated looks). The checks are one reasonable reading of each note on the measurable axes, not the only one: judge the sheets by eye as well. Do not tune prompts or hints on these cases. Frames: tests/data/frames (CC0, tests/data/SOURCES.md).

cases.notes: It's six in the morning, the sun has barely come up and nobody has had coffee yet.
Make it look like the postcard you'd buy at the beach kiosk.
Like it was pulled from a 1950s newsreel, the colour almost gone.
Something is about to go wrong in this crowd. Make me uneasy.
Late August heat, everyone a little sunburnt, the air is thick.
Grey sky, drizzle on the way, a bit of a dull Tuesday.
Give the faces a glow, like the light is coming off the sea at sunset.
I want this crisp and graphic, the shapes should hit you, but don't lose what's in the shadows.
cases.checks: more contrast, keep the blacks clean
